text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука and I have come to the
riverside
to run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What great weather. The sun is shining
so bright—
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув gave me some sunscreen the
other
day because she said my skin
looked a little
agitated.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I should go back home to get it. Sigh... If only the weather wasn't so nice, then I wouldn't need it.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But wait... If the weather were bad, then
it
wouldn't feel good to run anyway...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't take too long for Silence
Suzuka to
return from her room, but she
seems a little down
about losing some
running time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
